meta.title: Cornmeister.nl
meta.description: Real-time MeshCore Netherlands mesh network analyzer — live packet visualization, node tracking, channel decryption, route analysis, and deep mesh analytics.

home.heroSubtitle: Find your nodes to start monitoring them.

steps.title: First: Join the MeshCore Community
steps.description: Connect with other mesh enthusiasts in the community to get help and share experiences. Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/HfJVk9J29K

steps.title: Step 1: Connect via Bluetooth
steps.description: Flash BLE companion firmware from the MeshCore Flasher at https://flasher.meshcore.co.uk/. Screenless devices: default PIN 123456. Screen devices: random PIN shown on display. If pairing fails: forget device, reboot, re-pair.

steps.title: Step 2: Set the frequency for Nederland (EU/UK Narrow)
steps.description: Netherlands Recommended: 868 MHz · BW 62.5 kHz · SF 8 · CR 8 · 22 dBm. Example frequency: 869.618 MHz.

steps.title: Step 3: Advertise yourself
steps.description: Tap the signal icon → Flood to broadcast your node to the mesh. Companions only advert when you trigger it manually.

steps.title: Step 4: Check "Heard N repeats"
steps.description: "Sent" = transmitted, no confirmation. "Heard 0 repeats" = no repeater picked it up. "Heard 1+ repeats" = you're on the mesh!

steps.title: Repeaters near you?
steps.description: Check the network map at #/map to see active repeaters.

donate.title: The Cornmeister.nl Meshcore Analyzer runs on real hardware, processing tens of thousands of mesh packets around the clock. If it's useful to you, a small donation goes a long way toward keeping the server running.

modal.bodyNl: Wij maken sinds kort gebruik van de MQTT servers van DutchMeshCore.nl, heb jij jouw observers al aangepast naar deze servers? De mqtt.cornmeister.nl gaat binnenkort met vervroegd pensioen.
modal.bodyEn: We recently switched to the MQTT servers of DutchMeshCore.nl — have you already updated your observers to use these servers? mqtt.cornmeister.nl will be retiring soon.

observerSetup.html:
ℹ️ How to connect your observer to Cornmeister.nl▶
Connect your node to the DutchMeshcore.nl MQTT ingestors to share raw packets with Cornmeister.nl.
📍 Step 1 — Your region (IATA code)
Cornmeister.nl groups observers by the IATA airport code nearest to them. If your observer shows as Offline or doesn't appear in the list, you most likely haven't set this yet. Pick your region below — the commands update automatically.
✉️ Step 2 — Owner email address (optional)
Used for ownership verification or observer notifications.
⌨️ Step 3 — Paste into your device console
Requires the DutchMeshcore.nl MQTT Bridge firmware (Heltec, LilyGO, T-Beam, RAK and more).
MeshCore console
set mqtt.iata AMS
set mqtt.email 
set mqtt1.preset dutchmeshcore-1
set mqtt2.preset dutchmeshcore-2
reboot
⚡ Both ingestors required for high availability. If one goes down your observer stays connected via the other. mqtt1.preset → Ingestor 1  ·  mqtt2.preset → Ingestor 2.
🔧 Manual configuration (reference)
For custom firmware builds, generic MQTT clients, or anyone integrating directly without using the preset commands above.
Ingestor 1
Server:collector1.dutchmeshcore.nl
Port:443
Transport:WebSockets (TLS)
Ingestor 2
Server:collector2.dutchmeshcore.nl
Port:443
Transport:WebSockets (TLS)
Missing the info for your specific device? Take a look at the DutchMeshcore.nl toolbox.
